text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 31 units of the B. Braun amino acid product (NDC 00264193310) at 8.5 units per day, providing 4 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 30 units of the same B. Braun product at 1.2 units per day, providing 26 days on hand. Corvale General holds 128 units of the B. Braun product at 8.9 units per day, providing 14 days on hand, and also uses a Baxter product (NDC 00338049906). Detailed stock breakdowns confirm these aggregate days-on-hand figures.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list this drug as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Corvale East is at critical supply risk. Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General have sufficient inventory to support limited transfers without dropping below a two-week buffer. An alternative manufacturer (ICU Medical Inc.) is not on FDA's shortage list and represents a viable purchase option.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 13 units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 3 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
3. Initiate purchase from ICU Medical Inc. — approved by Buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or rationing at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
